Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.repository.liquidity

Interface KfeChannelCapacityJobRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity,UUID>
public interface KfeChannelCapacityJobRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity,UUID>
Queries and atomically claims asynchronous channel-capacity jobs for worker execution.

The bulk update operations encode the lease protocol directly in the database: a pending job or an expired in-progress claim can be acquired, only the matching live token can heartbeat, and only the current token can finish or fail a job. Returned update counts tell callers whether the compare-and-set transition won.

    • findClaimCandidates

      @Query("select j from KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity j\nwhere j.status = \'PENDING\'\n or (j.status = \'IN_PROGRESS\' and (j.leaseExpiresAt is null or j.leaseExpiresAt <= :now))\norder by j.createdAt asc, j.id asc\n") List<KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity> findClaimCandidates(@Param("now") LocalDateTime now, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Selects pending jobs and in-progress jobs whose worker lease has expired.
      Parameters:
      now - UTC instant used to evaluate expired claims
      pageable - batch size and ordering window for the worker poll
      Returns:
      oldest eligible jobs first, with UUID as a deterministic tie-breaker

    • claim

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity j\nset j.status = \'IN_PROGRESS\', j.claimedBy = :worker,\n j.claimToken = :token, j.leaseExpiresAt = :until\nwhere j.id = :id\n and (j.status = \'PENDING\'\n or (j.status = \'IN_PROGRESS\' and (j.leaseExpiresAt is null or j.leaseExpiresAt <= :now)))\n") int claim(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now, @Param("worker") String worker, @Param("token") UUID token, @Param("until") LocalDateTime until)
      Atomically acquires an eligible job and assigns its worker lease and fencing token.
      Parameters:
      id - job identifier to claim
      now - current UTC instant for testing whether an old lease has expired
      worker - identity of the worker taking ownership
      token - fresh opaque token that must accompany subsequent claim operations
      until - UTC expiry instant for the newly granted lease
      Returns:
      affected row count: one if the compare-and-set claim succeeded, otherwise zero

    • heartbeat

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity j\nset j.leaseExpiresAt = :until\nwhere j.id = :id and j.status = \'IN_PROGRESS\'\n and j.claimToken = :token and j.leaseExpiresAt > :now\n") int heartbeat(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("token") UUID token, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now, @Param("until") LocalDateTime until)
      Extends a still-live job lease only when the supplied token remains its current owner.
      Parameters:
      id - job identifier being renewed
      token - token returned to the current claimant
      now - current UTC instant; an already expired lease cannot be renewed
      until - new UTC lease expiry instant
      Returns:
      one when the matching unexpired claim was extended, otherwise zero

    • completeClaimed

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeChannelCapacityJobEntity j\nset j.status = \'COMPLETED\', j.providerReference = :reference,\n j.completedAt = :now, j.claimedBy = null, j.claimToken = null, j.leaseExpiresAt = null\nwhere j.id = :id and j.status = \'IN_PROGRESS\' and j.claimToken = :token\n") int completeClaimed(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("token") UUID token, @Param("reference") String reference, @Param("now") LocalDateTime now)
      Completes an in-progress job for the worker holding the matching claim token.
      Parameters:
      id - job identifier to complete
      token - current claim token proving worker ownership
      reference - provider operation reference to retain on the job
      now - UTC completion instant
      Returns:
      one when the matching active claim was completed, otherwise zero
